summary: Two hikers in jeans and tennis shoes lost the trail in a whiteout blizzard at ~12,800 ft on Mount Elbert on Saturday evening; they kept cell service and one walked for hours in 20-degree snow after losing a shoe; rescuers brought both off the mountain by ~5 a.m. Sunday into medical care
responding_agency: Chaffee County SAR North, Lake County Office of Emergency Management
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: SnowBrains story says "last Saturday"; page last-updated metadata resolves to 2020-11-13 (Friday), so the incident Saturday was 2020-11-07 (weekday-verified). Mount Elbert is in Lake County per the article. One hiker lost a tennis shoe; no injuries reported — recorded as rescued-uninjured per the unreported-outcome convention.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Mount Elbert); occurrence date approximate
